documents.title: Typed authentication-failure propagation from upstream branch invocation

documents.title: Isolated plugin-worker cancellation and shutdown hardening (upstream rpi-extensions fork)
documents.description: Implementation handoff for cooperative cancellation tokens, bounded thread settlement, and hard host-deadline process-tree termination in the isolated plugin worker, with the explicit FFI preemption limits.

documents.title: Upstream thinking-summary ordering gap in ScribeRig event adapter
documents.description: Investigation result: rpi-agent's thinking events cannot distinguish provider-visible reasoning summaries from raw thinking, so no ordered ReasoningSummary activity can be emitted safely; includes trace, evidence, and the required upstream API gap.

documents.title: DSH ACP worker bridge for Codex: full-access mode, provider override, and launcher fixes
documents.description: Operating notes and implementation handoff for the Codex→DSH ACP worker bridge in scriberig: danger-full-access support, acp profile provider override, cmd /q launcher fix, and known stdout noise.

documents.title: DSH delegated worker sessions persist as Ungrouped sessions in the desktop app
documents.description: Investigation evidence: every dsh_start/dsh_run ACP job creates a durable DSH session under ~/.dsh/sessions keyed by worker cwd, but never joins its workspace record, so the session browser lists it in the Ungrouped bucket.

documents.title: Agent-controlled DSH session continuation in the Codex worker bridge
documents.description: Implementation handoff: dsh_sessions discovery, session_id continuation via ACP session/resume, and session id surfaced at creation in playground/setup_dsh_codex_worker.py, with verified ACP method support and the active-session caveat.

documents.title: Codex–DSH worker bridge: arbitrary workspaces, user-scope registration, and trusted-root gating
documents.description: Implementation handoff for making the Codex→DSH MCP bridge usable from any Codex project: free-form workspace paths, user-level config by default, danger-full-access restricted to trusted roots, and structured rejection payloads because the MCP SDK hides exception text.

documents.title: Codex MCP client tool-call timeout: bounded dsh_run/dsh_wait protocol in the DSH worker bridge
documents.description: Why Codex aborts MCP tool calls at 300s regardless of worker timeout_seconds, the exact Codex config keys that change it, and the bounded-start/poll protocol (dsh_run returns running + job_id, dsh_wait long-polls ≤280s) implemented in the DSH worker bridge.
